text: Setting clear goals is the first step to a successful project. A useful framework is to create SMART goals, which means they are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Once your main goals are set, break them down into smaller milestones. These are checkpoints that help you track progress and stay on schedule. Each milestone should have clear deliverables, or tangible outputs, such as a report or a prototype. Finally, it is crucial to ensure stakeholder alignment. This means that everyone involved, from team members to clients, agrees on the objectives and expected outcomes. By working towards a shared vision, you can avoid confusion and keep the project moving forward efficiently.
